## Summary

## Evidence / example

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] Read-only default and explicit approval boundaries are preserved
- [ ] No secrets, proprietary code, personal information, or unauthorized third-party Skill content are included
- [ ] Documentation and CHANGELOG updated if applicable

## Trade-offs

What new overhead does this introduce? Which alternative did you reject?
